name: Bicclescombe Park Play Area
description: A play area at Bicclescombe Park in Ilfracombe, run by North Devon Council, which says it suits 3-13 year olds. Green Flag park with tennis courts, public toilets, model boating lake, Victorian gardens, mill and tea room.
